summary: BitBucketClient (issue #345 Part 2) fully achieves the saved plan, independently verified against the actual tree. src/awf/common/bitbucket_client.py (922 lines) + src/awf/common/bitbucket_client_parsing.py (419 lines) are both under the 1500-line guardrail and implement all 10 ForgeClient methods with the corrected BB Cloud REST v2.0 mappings: create_pull_request POST .../pullrequests; fetch_pr_status assembling PR + commit-status + comments (base_behind_count passed in); fetch_failing_check_logs via the pipeline-lookup chain with singular /steps/{uuid}/log + Range tail and pytest fallback; rerun_failed_workflow_jobs reconstructing pipeline_pullrequest_target with the iteration-1 hyphenated 'pull-requests' selector fix and conservative not-rerunnable fallback; resolve_thread POST .../resolve (never DELETE, thread-id encode/decode for missing PR context); post_comment; create_issue with 404 tracker-disabled PR-comment fallback; fetch_repo/branch merge methods from PR destination.branch.merge_strategies; merge_pr sending BB strategy values incl. first-class fast_forward. Locked decisions D1 (injected httpx.AsyncClient + from_env), D2 (shared _request: 429/Retry-After backoff, cursor pagination, bounded ETag/If-None-Match cache, X-RateLimit-NearLimit slow-down), D5 (merge mapping), D6 (explicit basic/bearer auth, BITBUCKET_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED, redaction, never logging Authorization) are honored. Gate flipped: _SUPPORTED_FORGES includes bitbucket and make_forge_client('bitbucket') returns BitBucketClient.from_env while unknown forges still raise. The 4 planned reason codes are in service/doctor/reasons.py and the regenerated REASON_CATALOG.md. Gate-flip regressions are flipped (test_forge.py returns a BitBucketClient + asserts membership; executor forge gate proceeds for bitbucket; adoption allowed). Out-of-scope edits are correct and consistent with the plan's non-goals: recovery_preserved_queries.py keeps the GitHub-only open-PR resolver rejecting bitbucket after the global flip, and db/enums.py is a docstring refresh. The #352 merge-gate seam was investigated and flagged (fast_forward-only BB repos conservatively NotifyHuman rather than mis-merge). The live-docs verification gate was completed in iteration 1 against the authoritative swagger.json, catching and fixing the pull-requests selector bug. The VALIDATION doc records focused pytest/ruff/mypy/coverage as green with 100% focused coverage on the new modules; broad .awf coverage/OpenAPI/whole-suite gates are AWF/CI-owned post-agent per the plan and the workspace contract. (Note: the VALIDATION doc states a stale 524-line count for bitbucket_client.py vs the actual 922; cosmetic only, the <1500 guardrail still holds.)
